verified_semantics.collision_getter: simulation.getCollidingVehiclesNumber returns last-step involved vehicles (typically 2 per collision); never event count
verified_semantics.summary: MSNet writes summary after step at pre-increment label; aligns with TraCI time label +0.05
verified_semantics.counter_identities: ended=arrived+discarded; inserted=running+arrived; discarded is never-inserted permanent removal
verified_semantics.pending: getPendingVehicles is explicit IDs waiting for insertion with delay
verified_semantics.identity_limit: Aggregate discarded count alone cannot resolve IDs
